page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by 96 dedicated physical cores of the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system features 736.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.67 GB per core. It is equipped with eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs, delivering a total of 256 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance is measured at 1104.49, placing it in the bottom 25% of tested servers. Conversely, the multi-core CPU performance is measured at 70674.73, positioning it in the top 25% of servers. This indicates a tradeoff where individual core speed is relatively low, but the massive parallel execution capability across 96 dedicated cores yields high aggregate compute throughput.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this server represents a high-density hardware profile designed for parallel workloads. The inclusion of eight enterprise-grade GPUs alongside a large memory footprint of 736.0 GB makes it suitable for workloads that can leverage massive GPU acceleration and parallel processing, such as deep learning training, complex scientific simulations, and large-scale parallel data processing. However, the lack of local storage requires users to factor in the cost and latency of external block storage.
